The [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] of '''Grand General''' was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]]. Although the Empire named twelve [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]], it only elevated a few to that of Grand General, and the rank was largely honorary.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" /> Despite this, [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] and zealot of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] [[Malcor Brashin]] served in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a grand general after climbing through the ranks following a string of victories and [[Gender/Legends|his]] commitment to destroying anarchists and [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]. Brashin became one of the Imperial Army's most respected and feared generals.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|92|Brashin, Grand General Malcor}}</ref>
